scope: VB ComboBox drop-down, drop-down-list and simple variants.
actual_source_basis: The original VB5/VB6 XP Styles Demonstration contains both a normal editable ComboBox and Style=Dropdown List.
The ImageProcessor sources use several Style=Dropdown List controls.
renderer_boundary: The exact ThunderRT5/6ComboBox path accepts the three public COMBOBOX styles. The existing renderer owns only the classic outer face, arrow and scoped list/EDIT font path; selection, popup, edit child and notifications remain native COMBOBOX responsibilities.
